question: Find the artist who illustrated the fewest cards that are legal in the 'commander' format and have an Italian translation. Return the English name, Italian name, and set name for all cards by this artist that have an Italian translation.

prediction.sql:
WITH qualifying AS (
    SELECT
        c.XCL_002 AS artist,
        c.XCL_049 AS english_name,
        fd.XCL_079 AS italian_name,
        s.XCL_110 AS set_name
    FROM cards c
    INNER JOIN legalities l ON c.XCL_072 = l.XCL_086
    INNER JOIN foreign_data fd ON c.XCL_072 = fd.XCL_082
    INNER JOIN sets s ON c.XCL_063 = s.XCL_099
    WHERE l.XCL_084 = 'commander'
      AND l.XCL_085 = 'Legal'
      AND fd.XCL_077 = 'Italian'
),
artist_counts AS (
    SELECT artist, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM qualifying
    GROUP BY artist
)
SELECT
    q.english_name,
    q.italian_name,
    q.set_name
FROM qualifying q
INNER JOIN artist_counts ac ON q.artist = ac.artist
WHERE ac.cnt = (SELECT MIN(cnt) FROM artist_counts)

    SELECT
        c.XCL_002 AS artist,
        c.XCL_003 AS english_name,

        c.XCL_063 AS set_name,

    INNER JOIN foreign_data fd ON c.XCL_072 = fd.XCL_082
